The '''SA-45 Technician Droid''' was a model of bipedal [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] used by the [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], a freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstitued Sith Empire]]. SA-45 Technician Droids supported the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces that defended the Shroud's factory on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
SA-45 Technician Droids appear as enemies in the final [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] mission&mdash;"The Shroud Revealed" for Republic players and "All the Pieces" for Imperials&mdash;in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
